preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The dimensions of the grid N and M must be between 2 and 1,000.

preconditions.expression: len(B) == N * M and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in B)
preconditions.description: The array B must contain N * M distinct elements, each between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(map(str, grid)) for grid in grids
postconditions.description: The output must be a grid of size N x M with elements from B, formatted as specified.

postconditions.expression: all(len(grid) == N and len(grid[0]) == M for grid in grids)
postconditions.description: Each grid must have N rows and M columns.

postconditions.expression: all(all(grid[i][j] in B for j in range(M)) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: All elements in the grid must be from the array B.
